description: Source code for Maxim DS3231 RTC driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing timekeeping, alarm, and synchronization functionalities.

methods.name: sc_ctrl
methods.description: Set and clear specific bits in the control register of DS3231.

methods.name: rsc_stat
methods.description: Read and modify the status register, setting bits atomically.

methods.name: validate_isw_monitoring
methods.description: Enable or disable monitoring of interrupt/square-wave signals based on current configuration.

methods.name: decode_time
methods.description: Decode time from register values into a tm structure.

methods.name: decode_alarm
methods.description: Decode alarm register data into a time_t and flags.

methods.name: encode_alarm
methods.description: Encode time and flags into alarm register format.

methods.name: decode_rtc
methods.description: Decode RTC register data into a counter value.

methods.name: update_registers
methods.description: Fetch current register values from the device.

methods.name: counter_alarm_forwarder
methods.description: Dummy handler for counter alarm callback.

methods.name: alarm_worker
methods.description: Worker thread to handle alarm events.

methods.name: sqw_worker
methods.description: Worker thread for square wave events.

methods.name: sync_finish
methods.description: Finalize synchronization process and notify waiting entities.

methods.name: sync_finish_read
methods.description: Complete synchronization read and store result.

methods.name: sync_worker
methods.description: Worker thread to handle synchronization steps.

methods.name: isw_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO interrupt callback for ISW events.

methods.name: ds3231_counter_set_alarm
methods.description: Set an alarm via counter API.
